title: KĀLA-YANTRA v3 packet front matter (relaunch plan v2.7 §8)
description: Front matter of 00_ARCHITECTURE/briefs/kalayantra/packets/PACKET_<ID>_v<n>.md, as a JSON object. This schema checks shape and the per-kind conditionals only. Not checked by this schema (kypacket.py check, plan §8): that packet_sha256 is the SHA-256 of the canonical content excluding that field; that every sha256 / commit names what it claims; that schema_receipt_id resolves to an admitted schema receipt; that excerpts and reconciliation claims match the pinned sources; the 4 k-token size limit; test availability. Validated with fleet/kyschema.py (supported keyword subset only).

id.description: The item id; also the <ID> of the packet file name, so it is one safe path component.

wave.description: "B" for the bootstrap wave, the integers 0-3 for the campaign waves (plan §14). The value is constrained by the kind, in allOf/0: bootstrap packets carry "B", every other kind one of 0, 1, 2, 3.

build_tier.description: The routed builder model tier (plan §4 roster, §9 routing).

max_loops.description: Fleet default is 2 (owner Amendment A2 D-17 §2.6, superseding plan §8); the default is NOT applied or enforced here, the field is required and must be an integer 1-5.

schema_receipt_id.description: The admitted schema receipt the packet's signatures come from; null only where the kind permits it (bootstrap). Its resolution to an admitted receipt is not checked by this schema.

intended_schema.description: schema-prerequisite packets only: the intended additive contract, declared next to the admitted existing schema (plan §8 section 4).

original_failing_base.description: Feature packets: the immutable commit on which the installed tests fail.

pw_mechanism_version.description: Version of the protected-window mechanism the packet was written against; null only where the kind permits it (bootstrap).

release_pins.description: "not_applicable: bootstrap" for bootstrap (Wave B) packets; otherwise the build snapshot id read from run/RELEASE_RECEIPT.json. Never main_sha, never a migration number (plan §8 section 1). The value is constrained by the kind, in allOf/0.

d1_paths.description: bootstrap packets only: the enumerated D-1 control-plane source paths the packet may change. Repository-relative, one explicit path each: no leading slash, no '.' or '..' segment, no glob.

acceptance.description: bootstrap packets: the command, its expected result and the negative cases (plan §14 B-1).

semantic_acceptance.description: artifact and operation packets: the explicit semantic acceptance (no invented red test).

allOf.$comment: bootstrap: release pins not applicable, enumerated D-1 paths, named acceptance, no chart data, Wave B, Opus, KV3-B-* id. Every other kind: real release pins, a campaign wave, a schema receipt and a protected-window mechanism version, and no control-plane paths.
feature: the immutable original failing base, the test commits and the observed failing assertion.
intended_schema: required for schema-prerequisite (id KV3-SCHEMA-<n>), forbidden for every other kind.
artifact / operation: explicit semantic acceptance and negative fixtures; a red test must not be invented, so the two red-test fields are absent or null.

revision.description: The pinned revision of the source (a commit id or the document's own version); the sha256 is what makes the pin immutable.
